title: The padding relative method code of JVM tableswitch starts to align
summary: Insert zero to three padding bytes after tableswitch so the following default offset is aligned to four bytes relative to the start of the method code.
applies: JVM class files and standard bytecode
detail: The displacement of each branch takes the tableswitch opcode address as the origin and is interpreted as signed 32 bits.
boundary: The starting offset of the entire file may not be congruent with the starting point of the method code; alignment based on the absolute position of the file will result in misreading.
relevance: Explanation All targets in the switch table appear to be misaligned by the same bias.
